purpose: Evaluate one exact, literature-supported Caputo contract for each manifest that failed the first long-horizon screen. This search is separate from formal manifest qualification.

selection_rule.pre_run_basis: One candidate per failed system was chosen before execution because the cited primary source reports the complete operator, vector field, q, h, and initial-state contract. No candidate was added or removed based on dynamic-screen results.
selection_rule.replacement_eligible: The candidate must pass every unchanged long-horizon screen at both frozen resolution divisors and the unchanged cross-resolution screen.
selection_rule.on_pass: Freeze the exact candidate as that system's v2 manifest. Preserve the already-qualified Chen manifest unchanged.
selection_rule.on_failure: Do not replace that system's manifest and record an explicit qualification blocker.
selection_rule.threshold_policy: No threshold, horizon, transient, resolution divisor, or diagnostic definition may be changed during or after this exploration.

source.citation: Feng et al., Fractal and Fractional 7 (2023) 887
evidence: Equation (1) gives the standard Lorenz vector field with Caputo derivatives.
The numerical method is Adams-Bashforth-Moulton predictor-corrector.
The paper sets h=0.001 and reports q=0.995 with parameters (10,28,8/3).
The first of the four explicitly listed initial states is (0.3,0.3,0.3); it was selected before execution.

source.citation: Wang, Wang, and Li, Journal of Low Frequency Noise, Vibration and Active Control 43 (2024) 609-616
evidence: Equation (1) gives the Rossler vector field with Caputo derivatives.
The numerical-experiment section fixes initial state (0.5,1.5,0.1) and h=0.01.
The immediately following Figure 2 experiment sets q=(0.9,0.9,0.9), parameters (0.5,0.2,10), and T=500.
